messages:
maya: Heads upHighAurum POC blocked by CISO. They need BYO KMS flow, SAML test plan, and 95th pct latency at 2k conc before legal signs. Can we get an exec bridge today?
andre: I can draft the BYO KMS flow (wrap/unwrap, audit events, rotation API). Need to confirm supported CSPs and HSM notes.
kira: I can run a focused perf run against their sample payloads. ETA ~90m for p50/p95/p99 on a Dedicated-like rig. Send the trace?
jordan: Pricing flag: they want a 6-mo committed discount discussion. Need to scope reserved capacity and burst tiers before bridge.
beth: Legal needs explicit KMS wording (customer-supplied keys, custody responsibilities, audit log retention). I can fast-review if eng text is concrete.
ops-bot: Canary test started: canary-resize -> infra-lab-7. Est completion 18m.
andre: Quick KMS draft: customer uploads public wrapping key to our KMS endpoint; we store wrapped model keys; unwrap only in HSM-backed enclave; wrap/unwrap events logged and pushed to customer SIEM. Will add diagram.
kira: first pass perf (toy env): p50 45ms, p95 230ms, p99 510ms. I'll re-run on the canary once infra test completes and post results.
maya: Please also prepare an automatic fallback option: smaller quantized model variant + canary rollback plan. CISO asked about graceful degradation.
jordan: For pricing I'll prepare 3 options: reserved baseline, reserved+burst, and a pilot credit path. Finance needs a signed SOW for any deep discount.
beth: Send the KMS draft and perf numbers into the doc. I'll draft contract clause + procurement checklist.
chris-cto: Confirm: do we support CMEK/CVMK and region parity limits? Also need confirmation of rotation cadence being customer-driven.
andre: Yeswe support AWS KMS CMKs and GCP CMEK; region parity noted in doc; rotation can be customer-triggered and we emit rotation event to SIEM.
maya: OK setting a 3:30pm PT exec bridge. Agenda: ask, responsibilities, risks+mitigations, timeline. Invite: CTO, legal, SE, ops, HighAurum CISO.
andre: I'll bring KMS diagram + runbook snippet. kira: bring finalized perf slides. jordan: bring pricing deck. beth: bring legal clause.
maya: Post-bridge action owner list promised. See calendar invite in thread. :thumbsup:
